luci-app-vantage.description: Vantage dashboard: read-only status of the device, uplink, radios and stations (wireless configuration without keys, through luci.vantage wireless)

luci-app-vantage-rdns.description: Vantage dashboard: client names from reverse DNS (lets the holder make the device send DNS PTR queries to any DNS server and port it names)

luci-app-vantage-names.description: Vantage dashboard: name stations (luci.vantage set_alias: validated names in /etc/config/vantage only, at most 512)
